sentences: Traders moved $530 million through Polymarket in the week of 2026-07-27, across 20.5 million individual trades. with 24,371 wallets placing their first-ever bet. Algorithmic wallets accounted for 76% of weekly counterparty events (both maker and taker sides counted); everyone else split the remaining 24%.
The most-traded market was "Will Spain win the 2026 FIFA World Cup?", pulling in $22 million of volume.
Both sides lost money on resolved trades this week. Bots dropped $5K (-95 bps); retail dropped $477 (-245 bps). Much of the activity was in markets that have not yet resolved.
